text:
sam: Heads up — we saw a spike of fncall rejects routing to the degen path around 10:03. Dashboard shows quota burn but no per-request reject reason, so product teams keep getting billed. :thinking:

frank: same. Console logs have `validation:tool_response_invalid_shape` in the ingest stream but the route_id is null. makes it hard to map to model variant. sample payload in logs:
```json
{"tool":"address_lookup","response": ["123 main st", null]}
```
Expected `\{"address\": \{\"line1\": string\}\}` — our schema enforcer treats arrays-as-mistyped and rejects.

maya: is this the strict-validate canary we flipped last week? iirc it should tag rejects with `validation.reason` and `route_id` in telemetry.

sam: I thought the canary included reason. check the ingest pipeline — last deploy had the validator change + a tiny change to the router that drops `route_id` when fallback triggers.

liz: confirmed — router sidecar sets route_id on success only. fallback path short-circuits before it adds the header. so the telemetry event lands with `route_id=null`.

noah: that explains console gap. two product issues: 1) customers see quota charged to primary route, 2) alerts fire on quota but Ops can't triage cause no route_id.

frank: proposal: patch router to attach `route_id` earlier, and add a `validation.reason` string to the fncall reject event. that keeps things backward compatible. also add a short `validation.hint` for common fixes (e.g., "expected object with key 'price'").

maya: for rollout UX — instead of a hard flip, can we soft-validate a subset (1%) and add a console badge that surfaces sample rejects with full context? product asked for a preview before a full strict rollout.

sam: yes. add a toggle in the Console > Routes page: "Schema soft-sample" with sampling rate slider and link to examples. when enabled it should generate created telemetry `fncall.validation.sampled` and not count against quota.

liz: careful — "not count against quota" needs infra hairpin. billing path currently counts at ingress time before we know validation outcome. we could emit a credit event `billing.adjustment` when we later mark sampled rejects as non-billable. ops-sre will hate that extra reconciliation but it's doable.

noah: alternative: route sampled validation traffic to a non-billing plan id so it's never charged. simpler from accounting side but requires quick routing rule support.

frank: scoreboard of action items: (a) router patch to preserve route_id on fallback (owner: liz), (b) add `validation.reason` + hint to telemetry + schema for the event (owner: sam), (c) implement Console sampling toggle + badge (owner: maya), (d) decide billing reconciliation vs non-billing route for samples (owner: finance + ops) — assign a meeting?

maya: i'll prototype the console toggle UI and a small table view showing sampled payloads with redacted PII. sample event fields: `trace_id`, `route_id`, `model_variant`, `validation.reason`, `payload_snippet` (redacted).

sam: nice. for telemetry naming let's standardize: `fncall.validation.reject` (counts), `fncall.validation.sampled` (observability only), `fncall.validation.reject.reason` (string tag), `billing.adjustment` (optional). keep keys flat for our metrics pipeline.

liz: FYI deploy-bot shows last router deploy id `deploy-2026-03-18-42` — revert/patch window is open until 14:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Revert window remaining 2h 10m for deploy-2026-03-18-42. :robot_face:

noah: can we add a lightweight console alert rule that surfaces when `fncall.validation.reject` spikes and includes a sample snippet link? ops needs something actionable.

frank: yes — create an alert template: title "fncall validation rejects up x%", include top 5 `validation.reason` and a link to sampled payloads. have it auto-assign to eng-platform on page.

maya: one more UX ask — in the Route detail page, show a small timeline of validation rejects and how many fell through to degen vs were handled. that helps PMs know exposure.

sam: agreed. i'll draft PR text for the telemetry event and a changelog note for the canary. also will add a consumer schema for `validation.reason` with enumerated common codes + freeform message.

liz: i'll pick up the router patch. will also add an integration test that verifies `route_id` persists for fallback flows.

noah: schedule meeting w/ finance and ops for billing approach 30m?

maya: sending invite now.

sam: thanks all. can we mark this as blocking the strict-validate full rollout until router + telemetry are in? :+1:

frank: +1

liz: +1 — working on it.
